mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT l.LIFE_ID AS lifeId, l.NAME AS name, l.BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, l.BIRTH_YEAR + NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, 0) AS deathYear, NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, 0) AS deathAge, c.NAME_KO AS birthCountry, p.MESSAGE AS message, NVL(p.TRIBUTE_COUNT, 0) AS tributeCount FROM MEMORIAL_POST p JOIN LIFE l ON l.LIFE_ID = p.LIFE_ID JOIN COUNTRY c ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY ORDER BY p.POST_ID DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE RN > #{start}

SELECT l.LIFE_ID AS lifeId, p.POST_ID AS postId, l.MEMBER_ID AS ownerId, l.NAME AS name, l.BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, l.BIRTH_YEAR + NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, 0) AS deathYear, NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, 0) AS deathAge, bc.NAME_KO AS birthCountry, cc.NAME_KO AS deathCountry, l.DEATH_CAUSE AS deathCause, NVL(l.CHILD_COUNT, 0) AS childCount, l.IS_MARRIED AS isMarried, l.OWNS AS owns, p.MESSAGE AS message, NVL(p.TRIBUTE_COUNT, 0) AS tributeCount FROM LIFE l JOIN COUNTRY bc ON bc.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY JOIN COUNTRY cc ON cc.COUNTRY_CODE = l.CURRENT_COUNTRY LEFT JOIN MEMORIAL_POST p ON p.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND l.STATUS = 'ENDED'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT j.JOB_NAME AS jobName, COUNT(*) AS years FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG y JOIN JOB j ON j.JOB_ID = y.JOB_ID WHERE y.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} GROUP BY j.JOB_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT NVL(ROUND(HAPPINESS), 0) FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY AGE

SELECT age, year, text FROM ( SELECT e.AGE AS age, e.YEAR_NO AS year, e.LOG_TEXT AS text FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG e JOIN GAME_EVENT g ON g.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID WHERE e.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND g.EVENT_TYPE = 'HIST' ORDER BY NVL(g.INTENSITY, 1) DESC, e.AGE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3 ORDER BY age
SELECT AGE AS age, YEAR_NO AS year, LOG_TEXT AS text FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND LOG_TEXT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY AGE, LOG_ID
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COUNTRY_CODE) FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_QUEST WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND ACHIEVED = 'Y'

SELECT c.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, c.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NICKNAME AS nickname, c.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM MEMORIAL_COMMENT c JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY c.COMMENT_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMORIAL_TRIBUTE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMORIAL_POST (POST_ID, LIFE_ID, MEMBER_ID, MESSAGE, VIEW_COUNT, TRIBUTE_COUNT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_MEMORIAL_POST.NEXTVAL, #{lifeId}, #{memberId}, #{message}, 0, 0, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO MEMORIAL_TRIBUTE (POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMORIAL_POST SET TRIBUTE_COUNT = TRIBUTE_COUNT + 1 WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
UPDATE MEMORIAL_POST SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMORIAL_COMMENT (COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_MEMORIAL_COMMENT.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MEMORIAL_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
